headline: Hyundai Unveils Mercury Electric Concept At Guangzhou Auto Show
seoTitle: Hyundai Unveils Mercury Concept at Guangzhou Auto Show
metaDescription: Hyundai Motor Co. showcased its new all-electric compact SUV concept at the Guangzhou auto show, with a production version planned for early 2027 in China.
aiSummaryBullets: Hyundai Motor Co. debuted an all-electric compact SUV concept car at the Guangzhou International Automobile Exhibition.
The vehicle, currently identified as the Mercury Concept, was presented on Friday at the event running until early December.
A production version of the concept is scheduled to launch in the Chinese market during the first half of 2027 under the name Ioniq M.
aiContextParagraph: Hyundai Motor Co. introduced its latest design direction for the Chinese market at the ongoing Guangzhou International Automobile Exhibition. The car manufacturer presented the Mercury Concept, an all-electric compact sport utility vehicle, marking a strategic move to expand its electric vehicle lineup in the region. According to official company statements released on Friday, this concept serves as a precursor to a production model officially titled the Ioniq M. The Guangzhou exhibition is scheduled to remain open to the public through December 6. Following the exhibition, Hyundai plans to initiate the commercial launch of the production model in China within the first half of 2027. This development reflects the company's broader efforts to transition its product portfolio toward electrification within key global automotive markets as competition in the electric vehicle sector continues to grow.
whyItIsViral: This story is trending due to reports from two major independent news outlets covering the international automotive event.
